title: Prelude in E Minor
short: Matteo Carcassi (1792–1853) · Em 6/8 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: A rippling study over the open low E string. Count two big beats in each bar, each split into six quick notes: thumb on the bass, then the fingers climb to the top string and come back down. Let the bass ring through the whole half bar. The last note is a harmonic: touch the 1st string lightly right over the 12th fret, pluck, and lift the finger.

blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: Méthode complète pour guitare, Op. 59 (1836): Preludes in Progressive Keys, No. 4 in E minor

sources.name: Mutopia Project edition of Carcassi’s Preludes in Progressive Keys, Op. 59 (entered by Jeffrey Olson from the 1906 Oliver Ditson edition by G. C. Santisteban; public domain). Upper and lower voices read twice and compared with this file note by note.
